rv.q: The timing is spectacular and the show is rife with both visual and spoken humor.
This hilarious theatrical parody of the movie that launched the spy/adventure/thriller/chase genre of film is a great way to spend a Summer afternoon or evening.
I found the first half somewhat entertaining but primarily lethargically dull, and I wasn't the only one.
If you go, you will undoubtedly be entertained by all the quality work here.

cn.t: Critics praise this laugh-out-loud farce that transforms Hitchcock's classic thriller into nonstop comedic action, with reviewers highlighting its clever parody and calling it an acting masterclass.
